components.name: ActionSwap
components.doc: A compact action that morphs through a small set of related states: idle, working, done, and back. Width, padding, tone, icon, and letters move together on one spring, and every change can be interrupted mid-flight.

members.name: pendingLabel
members.doc: Shown while `onAction` runs on the way into this state, such as "Sending" before "Sent". Without it the pill folds into a round spinner.

members.name: holdFor
members.doc: Milliseconds to hold this state before moving on by itself, for brief confirmations such as "Sent".

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Runs on press before the control moves on. Return a promise to show the working phase; a rejection shows `failureLabel`, then returns to the current state.
